{{Quote|It's easy to slice into Imperial files; they have computer-rigged pass-names. I make up my own codes myself. Usually animal names, like 'nerf,' or 'bhillen,' or even 'dog.'|Shannon Voorson, to Deen Voorson|<ref name="Slaying Dragons" />}} 
'''Bhillen''' was a type of [[Species/Legends|animal]] that could be eaten by [[Human/Legends|Humans]]. It could be [[Stewed bhillen|stewed]],<ref name="Slaying Dragons" />, [[Roast bhillen|roasted]],<ref name="Most Dangerous Foe">{{JournalCite|11|The Most Dangerous Foe}}</ref> or used to a prepare a [[Bhillen sandwich|sandwich]].<ref name="Slaying Dragons" />

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref>  the Human [[Technician/Legends|techician]] [[Deen Voorson]] recounted the story of about the Human [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Vici Ramunee]] to two fellow members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], [[Mavis]] and [[Tarn (Rebellion)|Tarn]]. In the story,<ref name="Most Dangerous Foe" /> set around [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]],<ref name="TERC" /> Ramunee found a spreed of food on a table that included a quarter roast bhillen only for it to vanish from the table after she turned away.<ref name="Most Dangerous Foe" /> 

By [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Deen's cousin, [[Shannon Voorson]], had learned to [[Slicer/Legends|slice]] into [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] data files while living in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Kuat system/Legends|Kuat System]]. Afterwards she would make up her own codes using animal names such as bhillen. When Deen visited Shannon in the Kuat System that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the family caught up with each other over a pot of stewed bhillen. Shannon later used a bhillen sandwich as part of a lie to get past a security guard and join her cousin in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="Slaying Dragons" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bhillen first appeared as stewed bhillen in "[[Slaying Dragons]]," a [[1996]] short story written by [[Angela Phillips]] published by [[West End Games]] in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 9|ninth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]''.<ref name="Slaying Dragons" />
